gaps.where: A sent document → Who signs, each signer's Copy their link (web) / Send their link (phone)
gaps.gap: Real part: no Assistant tool returns a signer's private link. Nothing in packages/core/src/assistant or apps/worker/src/assistant mentions signers, signerUrlFor or moneyLinks, and the assistant executor gets only webUrl, not the link-signing keys. So "what's Dana's signing link?" can't be answered without guessing. Not a gap: "text her the link again". do_document_remind (document.remind, risk 2) sends the link again by email and text to whoever's turn it is, so re-sending is covered.
gaps.fix: Add a look-up `document_signer_link {signerId}` (autonomy auto, permission documents.send). Put its spec in packages/core/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts and its worker in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts. Pass the worker's MoneyLinks (deps.moneyLinks) into the assistant executor the way webUrl is passed (tools-write.ts:255/917). Repeat the checks from POST /v1/documents/link (routes.ts:337-357): documents.send, a signer row seen as the person, and the document out or completed. Then return signerUrlFor(tx, links, signerId) run inside asWorker, as a full https URL. Its description should repeat DOCUMENT_SCREEN_WORDS.linkCopied ('It opens the document as them, so only send it to them') and say that do_document_remind sends it to them again.

gaps.where: find_capabilities: "can customers sign contracts / can I send an agreement to sign?"
gaps.gap: CORE_CAPABILITIES has no entry for Documents to sign. find_capabilities returns sets.current, built from core capabilities plus add-ons, so documents never appear. The planned 'esignature' entry still says 'Customers already approve estimates by typing their name. This adds signing for any document.' That overlap note is now stale, and anyone with addons.manage who passes includePlanned sees it.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/addons/capabilities.ts, after money.plans, add {id:'documents.signing', label:'Documents to sign', description:'Contracts and agreements customers sign online: make a template from your PDF, fill it in from HandsFreeOS, and send it to sign one after another or all at once, with reminders, a 6-digit code, voiding, and the signed copy filed on their Files.', permission:'documents.send'}. Without the permission it then lands in `restricted` (ask an admin). In packages/core/src/addons/planned.ts, rewrite the esignature overlap (around :869) and add a contracts overlap (around :853), so both say core Documents already makes PDF templates filled from HandsFreeOS, signer order, reminders and a filed signed copy.

Add howTo lines for remind, void then send it again, copy a signer's link, and make and fill a template. gaps.where: A sent document: the Voided, Declined and Out-of-time notes, What happened (the proof trail), Open the signed copy, and the filled-in pages
gaps.gap: Real part: the kernel parses output in schema key order (execute.ts:937), so DocumentGetOutput reads id, name, status, finishing, templateId, about, sentAt, expiresAt, completedAt, sentBy, signers (from the base shape), then definition, values, valuesBy, message, signingOrder, remind*, source, signed, hashes, voidedAt, voidReason, declinedAt, expiredAt, steps, canSend. A drawn signature's PNG data URL (up to 300,000 characters) in `values`, or a long definition, pushes past the 16,000-character cut. After that the Assistant loses the document-level void reason and dates, signing order, message, the signed copy, the proof trail (steps) and canSend. Overstated: status, finishing, and each signer's status, contact details, signedAt, declineReason, openedAt and ip come before the cut, so 'is it signed / who hasn't signed' still works. document.get has no option for less, so the note 'ask it for less' can't be followed.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/schemas/document.ts:361, move `definition`, `values`, `valuesBy`, `sourceSha256` and `signedSha256` to the end of the DocumentGetOutput.extend object, after steps and canSend. Extension keys keep their written order, so the cut then falls only on them. Better: in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-screen-reads.ts runScreenRead, special-case document.get (or add a per-query 'lean' hook in screen-reads.ts) to replace each signature value's `image` with a mark like 'drawn signature' (keep kind, how, name) and drop field and edit geometry. Add a test that a document with a drawn signature reads whole.

gaps.where: Template editor: changing one thing (a When it's sent setting, one field's Who fills it in, Has to be filled in, Fill in from HandsFreeOS, Choices or Text size, or a role in Who signs)
gaps.gap: do_document_template_save is the only way to change a template, and it replaces the whole definition. The handler parses `{...input.definition, pages, presets:{}}` with DocumentDefinition, where fields and edits default to [], so a call that leaves them out removes every field and word change. It is risk 1, but every screen action above risk 0 waits for Confirm, so a card is shown. That card prints the definition through valueOf → clip(JSON, 300), so the loss isn't visible. read_document_template_get puts definition first and cuts at 16,000 characters, so a long template can't be copied back whole.
gaps.fix: Add a hand-written `manage_document_template` (spec in packages/core/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts, worker in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts, permission documents.manage, autonomy confirm). It reads the template at commit and applies a patch: settings fields, roles through core's withRoleAdded/withRoleChanged/withRoleMoved/withoutRole (documents/edit.ts:255-290), and change or remove one field or edit by id. It saves with baseRevision = the revision it read. Its card says the change in words ('Turn off reminders on “Service agreement”'). Then drop 'document_template.save' from SCREEN_ACTIONS (coverage.ts:102), or keep it with a warning. At the least, give DocumentTemplateSaveInput a definition schema whose fields and edits are optional without defaults, and have the handler keep current.definition.fields and edits when they're absent.

gaps.where: A sent document: Open the signed copy, Download (web); Open the signed copy, Share the signed copy (phone)
gaps.gap: The screens open the signed PDF (and the source PDF) through a short-lived Supabase Storage signed URL made as the person. read_document_get returns only {fileId, name, bucket, objectPath}, and no Assistant tool makes a Storage link: grep finds no createSignedUrl, bucket or objectPath under assistant/. Nothing tells the Assistant that the signed copy is filed, locked, on the customer's Files tab either.
gaps.fix: Add a look-up `document_file_link {documentId, which:'signed'|'source'}` (permission records.read, auto) in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts, spec in packages/core/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts. It reads document.get as the person and creates a Storage signed URL for that bucket and objectPath with the person's own token, as apps/web/src/lib/documents/files.ts documentFileUrl does (300 seconds, like the screen), and returns the full https URL. Its description should say the signed copy is also on the customer's page, Files tab ('The signed copy is on their Files, locked', documents/words.ts:282).

gaps.where: The Confirm card for sending, voiding or reminding a document
gaps.gap: Screen-action cards come from cardFields over the raw arguments. For do_document_send that gives 'Template id: <uuid>', 'About: {"personId":…}', 'Signers: N items', and 'Values: {}' and 'Settings: {}' once defaults apply. Void shows 'Document id: <uuid>' and 'Reason', and remind shows only 'Document id: <uuid>'. A risk-2 send to customers is confirmed without the template's name or who gets it. The screen shows names, for example 'Void “Service agreement”?'.
gaps.fix: Add an optional `card` hook to ScreenAction in packages/core/src/assistant/coverage.ts, or special-case these in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-screen-actions.ts prepareScreenAction (:93-121), for document.send, document.void and document.remind. For send, read document_template.get for the name and the about record and signers (document.prefill gives names, emails and phones), and draw 'Send “Service agreement” to Dana Smith (dana@…, text 555-…) and you, about Dana Smith'. For void, use DOCUMENT_SCREEN_WORDS.voidTitle(name) with the reason under 'Why (they see this)'. For remind, '“Name”: a reminder goes to <the signers whose turn it is>'.

gaps.where: Send a document: the warnings at the top (what stops it going out) and who each role suggests; Template editor: Before it can go out
gaps.gap: DocumentPrefillOutput reads templateId, name, definition, presets, then signers, copies, message, source, issues. DocumentTemplateGetOutput reads id, name, revision, definition, then source and issues. A template with many fields or word changes (up to 300 each, `original` up to 2,000 characters) is cut at 16,000 characters before the Assistant sees who each role suggests or what stops it going out.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/schemas/document.ts, reorder DocumentPrefillOutput (:243) to templateId, name, issues, signers, copies, message, source, then definition and presets. Reorder DocumentTemplateGetOutput (:160) to id, name, revision, issues, documentsOut, updatedAt, archivedAt, source, then definition. The kernel's output parse follows schema order. Optionally trim the definition in runScreenRead for these two queries to {roles, settings, fields:[id,type,role,label,required,fillFrom,options]}.

gaps.where: Template editor: Place fields for me (web header button; phone too)
gaps.gap: Place fields for me is a worker route (/v1/documents/place-fields), not a command. The web finds spots and posts them; the phone posts none and the worker finds them on the stored PDF. The result goes on with addPlacedFields and is saved with document_template.save. No Assistant tool calls it, and it is in neither SCREEN_ACTIONS nor NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT, because the coverage test checks only commands.
gaps.fix: Add `place_template_fields {templateId}` (permission documents.manage, autonomy confirm because it saves the template; usage counts as 'documents' against the AI limit, as the route does). It calls the same placeFields(deps, actor, {workspaceId, templateId, roles: current roles}) with no spots, so the worker finds them on the stored PDF (place.ts header). It applies addPlacedFields (packages/core/src/documents/place.ts:559) to the template read at prepare time and saves with that baseRevision. The card says 'Place N fields on “Name” (M already there are kept)'. Or list it with a reason in coverage.ts. Separately, extend packages/core/test/assistant-coverage.test.ts to list the worker routes the documents screens call (place-fields, link, pages).

gaps.where: Template editor: Change words and Add words (The PDF's words); Send screen: Change the words for <customer> only; reading what the contract says
gaps.gap: Real part: the Assistant can't read a template's PDF words or each line's box. Only POST /v1/documents/pages returns them, so it can't build a document_send `edits` entry or a template edit over the right line, and it can't quote a template's clauses. Overstated: read_search_everything ('search.everything' is a screen read) searches the words inside files filed on records, with page snippets. That finds clause words in signed copies on customers' Files, though not the template's own PDF.
gaps.fix: Add a look-up `read_document_pages {templateId | documentId, from?, count?}` (permission documents.send or documents.manage, auto) in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-extra.ts, backed by the same reader as apps/worker/src/documents/pages.ts:464. It returns each page's lines as {text, x, y, w, h} with no pictures, a page at a time, so the Assistant can quote the contract and pass `original` and the box exactly in an edit.

gaps.where: What customers see: the signing page a signer's link opens, and their portal's documents
gaps.gap: CUSTOMER_PAGES lists booking, booking-confirmation link, estimate, invoice, plan and form pages, but not the signing page (/d/<link>) or the portal's documents. The Assistant has no words for what a signer sees.
gaps.fix: Add a CUSTOMER_PAGES line in packages/core/src/assistant/places-map.ts (after :639), using SIGNING_WORDS: 'A document to sign: each signer's own private link, in their email or text (or Copy their link on the document); when the template asks, they get a 6-digit code first; they tick I agree to sign electronically, draw or type their signature, then Finish and sign, or Decline to sign; works on a phone; everyone gets the signed copy (Download the signed copy); their portal lists their documents too'. Keep it free of '→'.

gaps.where: Ways into Documents: a customer's page Document button (web and phone), Documents in the phone's More, Documents hidden without the send permission
gaps.gap: Three omissions. The web customer page shows Document, for a person, to holders of documents.send, opening /documents/send?person=<id>; the phone has it in its actions too. Neither is in the top-row list at places-map.ts:160. The phone's More shows Documents to whoever can send them, and PHONE_APP's More line leaves it out. MENU_NEEDS hides Documents without documents.send, but EVERY_PAGE says only Inbox, Money and Audit log need their own permission.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/assistant/places-map.ts: at :160, add 'Document (whoever sends documents)' before 'and Add to workflow…', plus a howTo 'Send them a document to sign: their page, press Document'. At :625, add 'Documents (for whoever sends them)' after Forms. At :610, change to 'Inbox, Money, Documents and Audit log need their own permission'.

gaps.where: Settings → Permissions: the Documents card (Send documents to sign, Make document templates)
gaps.gap: Settings → Permissions draws a card for each PERMISSION_GROUPS entry, including 'Documents' (Send documents to sign, Make document templates). The settings map's onScreen list leaves Documents out. manage_permissions can already set these permissions (its enum is PERMISSION_KEYS), so only the words are missing.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/assistant/settings-map.ts:221, change the list to 'Contacts, Inbox and calls, Calendar, Money, Documents, Automations and AI, and Business and team'. Optionally add a howTo: 'Who can send documents or make templates: Settings → Permissions, the Documents card (Send documents to sign, Make document templates)'.

gaps.where: Send it (after Confirm): the screen opens the new document's page
gaps.gap: commitScreenAction ignores executeCommand's output and returns {outcome:'Done', href:null}. CommittedAction has no field for output at all. After a confirmed do_document_send, the panel has no link to the new document, and the model doesn't get documentId, signer ids or expiresAt.
gaps.fix: In apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-screen-actions.ts:125-133, keep the output. For document.send, set href to `/app/w/${ctx.workspaceId}/documents/${output.documentId}`; a per-command href hook on ScreenAction would cover others. To give the model the ids, add an optional `result` field to CommittedAction (apps/worker/src/assistant/runtime.ts:129) and pass it back on the next turn.

gaps.where: Sent filters and signer badges: All, Out for signing, Signed, Declined, Voided, Out of time; Not their turn yet, Link on its way, Signs with you in person, Gets a copy, Making the signed copy
gaps.gap: Overstated: read_document_list's input schema carries the enum (out, completed, declined, voided, expired), so the model sees the valid values, and a wrong one returns a validation error it can correct. Real part: the description words ('signed', 'out of time') don't match the enum. Signer status comes back as raw 'waiting', with nothing telling the model the screen's rule (Not their turn yet / Link on its way / Signs with you in person). `finishing` and kind 'copy' are bare fields, while the screen says 'Making the signed copy' and 'Gets a copy'.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/queries/document.ts:202, word the description as '…only those in one state: out (Out for signing), completed (Signed), declined, voided, expired (Out of time)…'. Then add a `label` to each signer (signerStatusLabel, words.ts:60) and to each document (documentBadge(status, finishing).label, words.ts:22) in the list and get outputs. Or, at the least, explain these rules in the document.list and document.get descriptions.

gaps.gap: The void dialog labels the reason 'Why (they see this)', and the voided notice to signers carries it (jobs.ts:376-395). DocumentVoidInput.reason has no description, and the command says only 'anyone who had their link is told', so the Assistant isn't told the reason is shown to customers.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/schemas/document.ts:281, add .describe('Why, in a sentence the signers read in their notice, like “The start date was wrong. A corrected copy is on its way.”'), which is DOCUMENT_SCREEN_WORDS.voidReasonExample. Optionally add to the document.void description (commands/document.ts:574) 'The reason goes to them.'
